title: US IRC section 121: amount of gain excluded on a single or joint return

output.name: excluded_gain
output.source: Section121TwoPersons.income_excluded_from_gross_income (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:85, 250-254) with income_excluded_from_gross_income_uncapped (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:84, 219-224). Labels follow the cases of 26 U.S.C. 121: no_exclusion when (a) is not met or (b)(3) applies (uncapped amount $0); limited_to_250000 when the gain reaches the (b)(1) limitation; limited_to_500000 when it reaches the (b)(2)(A) limitation; entire_gain when the whole gain is excluded below the applicable limitation

exclusions.description: On a single return, and on a surviving spouse's return in this scope, there is one taxpayer: the scope takes person 2 to be person 1 (section_121.catala_en:101-105), so a row whose person-2 labels differ from the person-1 labels describes no return
exclusions.predicate: return_type in ('single', 'surviving_spouse') and ((person1_ownership_days_in_5_years == 'lt_730_days' and person2_ownership_days_in_5_years == 'ge_730_days') or (person1_ownership_days_in_5_years == 'ge_730_days' and person2_ownership_days_in_5_years == 'lt_730_days') or (person1_use_days_in_5_years == 'lt_730_days' and person2_use_days_in_5_years == 'ge_730_days') or (person1_use_days_in_5_years == 'ge_730_days' and person2_use_days_in_5_years == 'lt_730_days') or (person1_other_section_121a_sale == 'none' and person2_other_section_121a_sale == 'within_2_years') or (person1_other_section_121a_sale == 'none' and person2_other_section_121a_sale == 'more_than_2_years') or (person1_other_section_121a_sale == 'within_2_years' and person2_other_section_121a_sale == 'none') or (person1_other_section_121a_sale == 'within_2_years' and person2_other_section_121a_sale == 'more_than_2_years') or (person1_other_section_121a_sale == 'more_than_2_years' and person2_other_section_121a_sale == 'none') or (person1_other_section_121a_sale == 'more_than_2_years' and person2_other_section_121a_sale == 'within_2_years'))
exclusions.source: us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:95-105 (person1 and person2 both read the single PersonalData of SingleReturn and SingleReturnSurvivingSpouse); 26 U.S.C. 121(b)(1)

notes: Sub-table 2 of 2 of US-121. Section121TwoPersons is the scope the official tests use; it has no (b)(2)(B) or (b)(4) rule (those are in Section121TwoPasses, whose PeriodMerge is a placeholder that returns [] and which no official test exercises), so a surviving spouse is treated like a single filer and a joint return that misses (b)(2)(A) gets the $250,000 limitation. REJECTED rows: any row with another section 121(a) sale for a person raises the DateError of us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:376 (US-121-1 notes).
